title: RNA extraction from Aiptasia larvae using Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Microprep Plus Kit
author: Christian CR Renicke
materials: Zymo Research Quick-DNA/RNA Microprep Plus Kit

steps.title: Collect Aiptasia larvae
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 200 larvae in 40 µL ASW into a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Use a 10-µL or 20-µL pipet with 10-µL XL tips (e.g., Eppendorf Research Plus 2 – 20 µL, light gray, 3123000098).
If necessary, concentrate larvae by performing a series of pipetting steps into smaller drops of ASW on a polystyrene surface (e.g., 60-mm disposable Petri Dish lid).

steps.title: Prepare samples
steps.instruction: Thaw samples at room temperature (RT) until they reach RT, then vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Stabilize samples
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL 1× DNA/RNA Shield to the samples and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Optional protein digestion
steps.instruction: To increase RNA yield, add Proteinase K and PK Digestion Buffer to the 160-µL samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 µL Proteinase K.
Add 16 µL PK Digestion Buffer.
Create a master mix if processing multiple samples.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 368 µL 100% ethanol to the 368-µL sample and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT.
SAVE the flow-through, as it contains the RNA.

steps.title: Optional column transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample into a Zymo-Spin IC-XM Column (yellow) sitting in a 1.5-mL nuclease-free tube to facilitate the later DNase I step.

steps.title: Lyse samples
steps.instruction: Add 184 µL DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer (equal to sample volume) to the samples and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Incubate at 25°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a Zymo-Spin IC Column (clear) sitting in a 2-mL collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column using DNA/RNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Perform DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of the DNase I reaction mix directly to the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.

steps.title: Clean column after DNase
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove DNase and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer, spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT, and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer, spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT, and discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer, spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT, and discard flow-through.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the dry column into a new nuclease-free 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL of 65°C-warm nuclease-free water directly to the column and spin at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT.
Re-apply the eluate onto the column and spin again at 16,000 ×g for 1 min at RT.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the final eluate into a fresh nuclease-free 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Take an aliquot for quality control if desired.
Store remaining RNA at −80°C or proceed with downstream applications.
